experiment: negative GLACIER same-formula top-five within-list rerank on 068a MassBank panel, fixed budget
protocol: The device comparison covers local CPU reranking of frozen candidates. Source ranks were previously generated on Kaggle. This run uses neither a new 0.505 full fusion nor a leaderboard submission.

Candidate membership frozen. Only the incumbent leader’s formula and its original ranks 1–5 are eligible slots. Each arm sorts those covered slots by predicted/observed entropy similarity, stably. No score would leave a slot fixed. No truth or extra identity is injected.

All 47 queries lack collision_energy_ev. Both arms use the released runner fallback, merging predictions at 20, 40 and 60 eV and scoring the merged prediction. LC-ESI-QFT maps to Orbitrap and LC-ESI-QTOF to QTOF. Neither source panel was measured on timsTOF.
route_change: Replace is_covered positive-mode and H/Na predicate with mode == negative and adduct == [M-H]-. Both arms run the same patched code on CPU with 3 threads, batch size 16, site none.

exposure_audit.scope: Reported intersections use stored keys. Shared scaffolds or spectral pretraining beyond that manifest may remain.
